methodology: Same deterministic input per workload, source indexes and disposable Mongo fixture. Release Rust versus compiled JavaScript Node; source compilation happens outside measured children, one long-lived process per run. Pair/language order rotates. GNU time peak RSS and user+system CPU include startup/shutdown; harness elapsed includes spawn. afterWarmup excludes exactly 1000 events for every batch size and includes the final empty poll; a partial warmup batch is used if needed. Throughput is null if no events remain after warmup. This is limited warmup, not full JIT stabilization. Legacy firstBatch/remaining metrics are retained. Batch latency summaries cover successful nonempty batches, excluding the final empty poll; afterWarmupBatch summaries exclude warmup batches. Pending-query executionStats are collected before each measured run and warm its collection/index pages. TS reference omits cron telemetry/bootstrap. Mongo CPU/RAM and whole-host effects are excluded from worker metrics. Synthetic fixtures on a shared host do not establish production or API performance guarantees.

environment.workingChanges: Adaptive idle policy and fixture driver instrumentation; projector production logic unchanged
